plan: x east along the street from the lot's left (west) corner, y north from the street, feet

not_drawn.rooms, doors and windows: the spreadsheet describes the house as a box (its footprint, height and stories): no interior, so egress waits ('no rooms drawn yet') and is not part of this eval
not_drawn.floors between the stories: the spreadsheet gives 3 stories (Inputs!B13) but no floor heights; Revit's Check my project doesn't count native floors as stories (only Gordium's floor blocks or a stated count, places/ithaca_city/measure.py _stories), so drawing them would invent heights and change nothing

assumptions.what: The walls 6 in thick, their outer faces on the spreadsheet's 53 x 35 ft outline
assumptions.why: the spreadsheet gives the house's outside size only
assumptions.effect: none: coverage, the yards and the height are measured to the outer faces and the top

assumptions.what: The roof a 12 in flat slab (a Revit floor) whose top is the 35 ft height
assumptions.why: the spreadsheet's house is a box; a roof's thickness isn't given
assumptions.effect: none: the height is measured to the top

assumptions.what: The flat ground drawn as four spot grades at 0, 1 ft outside each wall
assumptions.why: the Revit reader reads the ground only from spot-grade markers (Gordium: Ground from); spreadsheet_design_model_facts.yaml states the ground flat at 0
